description:
The Olympus is more than an all-mountain hardtail, it's the culmination of over 40 years of titanium craftsmanship. Designed and handcrafted in Chattanooga, Tennessee by the Lynskey family, every frame reflects decades spent refining the art and science of building titanium bicycles that riders trust on the world's most demanding trails.

Titanium has always been at the heart of what we do. Its unmatched combination of strength, low weight, corrosion resistance, and natural vibration damping creates a ride unlike any other material. The Olympus harnesses these qualities to deliver a hardtail that feels remarkably composed over rough terrain, absorbing trail chatter while remaining responsive when every pedal stroke and line choice matters.

Built for aggressive trail riding and all-day mountain adventures, the Olympus blends modern trail geometry with the unmistakable ride quality that has made titanium legendary. It climbs efficiently, descends with confidence, and tracks precisely through technical terrain, inspiring riders to push farther and ride longer without sacrificing comfort or control.

Every weld, every tube, and every detail is the product of hands-on craftsmanship backed by four decades of experience. We don't simply assemble frames, we build each Olympus one at a time with the care, precision, and pride that have defined the Lynskey name for generations.

Unlike materials that fatigue or fashions that fade, titanium is an investment in a lifetime of riding. It won't rust, resists corrosion in every environment, and maintains the ride quality that has made it the benchmark for discerning cyclists around the world. The Olympus is built to withstand countless miles of rugged singletrack, mountain epics, and everything in between.

When you ride the Olympus, you're not just riding another mountain bike. You're riding the legacy of a family that has spent more than four decades perfecting titanium bicycles—creating a frame that's built to be ridden hard, cherished for years, and passed down with stories still waiting to be written.
